description: This file contains API client functions for interacting with a backend server, including health checks, file uploads, and fetching test suite data. It also includes utility functions for URL resolution and error handling.

methods.name: resolveApiBase
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL from environment variables or defaults to localhost:3001.

methods.name: readJsonOrText
methods.description: Reads response content as JSON if possible, otherwise as text, and wraps text in an object with 'detail' key.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL with query parameters based on provided path and query object.

methods.name: safeFetch
methods.description: Wraps fetch to catch network errors and provide detailed error messages including the URL.

methods.name: checkBackendHealth
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the root endpoint to check backend health.

methods.name: importTestPlanFile
methods.description: Uploads a test plan file (CSV/XLSX) to the backend import endpoint.

methods.name: fetchSuites
methods.description: Fetches all test suites with counts.

methods.name: fetchSuiteTestcases
methods.description: Fetches paginated test cases for a specific suite with optional filters.

methods.name: getApiBase
methods.description: Returns the current API base URL for display or debugging.
